assistantGuides.text: The portfolio does not state a class standing or age. State the facts instead: Davis started at UNC Charlotte in August 2024 after dual enrollment at Catawba Valley Community College and expects to graduate in May 2027, so the 2026-27 academic year is his final year. Older notes that mention being a junior or a specific age are dated writing.

Projects that best show full-stack work (data or backend through a production web interface), all built by Davis unless noted: Contender (/projects/contender): FastAPI analysis service, NBA ingestion into Supabase Postgres, background jobs, Next.js and TypeScript product, Clerk and Stripe. Flowcast (/projects/flowcast): data pipeline, SageMaker training, serverless inference API, and a Next.js and MapLibre product. DHLM (/projects/dhlm): Next.js workspace with source routing, Google Workspace integrations, Supabase, and confirmed actions. Lakeside Sport Club (/projects/lakeside-sport-club): a storefront with server-side pricing, Stripe checkout, and order and inventory workflows. CrownCode AI (/projects/crowncode-ai): Next.js app with a server-side Claude integration. SecondChance (/projects/secondchance): Davis built the Next.js web application for a four-person team project.

Machine-learning and data work: Flowcast (XGBoost demand forecasting on AWS SageMaker), Contender (rules projection blended with a Random Forest, Ridge fallback), SecondChance (team LightGBM models; Davis built the web app), the Kewaunee analytics suite (Power BI and Zoho Analytics dashboards, DAX, data quality), the NYPD crime analysis (chi-square testing and logistic regression), the Census team paper (correlation, ANOVA, chi-square), and ProspectIQ (data normalization, enrichment, and scoring pipeline).
